scenario.title: 跟外國朋友介紹過年、中秋、元宵
scenario.context: 介紹台灣文化時，常要說明「那是大家…的時候」「那是我們…的地方」「這就是為什麼…」。英文用關係副詞 where / when / why 把地點、時間、原因接在名詞後面，讓解釋更流暢、更有條理。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: So what's Lunar New Year like in Taiwan?
lines.zh: 所以台灣的農曆新年是怎樣的？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's the one time of year when everyone goes back to their hometown. Families go all out.
lines.zh: 那是一年中大家都會回老家的時候，每個家庭都傾盡全力準備。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: On New Year's Eve, we have a big dinner at the house where our grandparents live. Then we ring in the new year with fireworks.
lines.zh: 除夕夜我們會在爺爺奶奶住的房子吃年夜飯，然後放煙火迎接新年。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: And the red envelopes? My coworker was talking about them.
lines.zh: 那紅包呢？我同事有講到。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh, that's the reason why kids love New Year. Adults give them money in red envelopes for good luck.
lines.zh: 喔，那就是小孩愛過年的原因。大人會把錢放在紅包裡給小孩，祝他們好運。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: That's a far cry from Christmas in Canada. We just get socks.
lines.zh: 跟加拿大的聖誕節差太多了，我們只收到襪子。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Why is everyone barbecuing on the sidewalk?
lines.zh: 為什麼大家都在人行道上烤肉？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's Mid-Autumn Festival. It's a thing here. Nobody really knows the reason why barbecue became the tradition.
lines.zh: 今天是中秋節，這是這裡的習俗。沒人真的知道為什麼烤肉會變成傳統。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Seriously? I thought it was about the moon.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？我以為是跟月亮有關。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It is. It's the night when the moon is fullest. We eat mooncakes and pomelos too.
lines.zh: 是啊，那是月亮最圓的晚上。我們也會吃月餅和柚子。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Is there a place where I can join a barbecue?
lines.zh: 有地方可以讓我加入烤肉嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Come to my building's rooftop. My neighbors always invite everyone.
lines.zh: 來我們大樓頂樓，我鄰居都會邀請大家。

patterns.en: The closest thing in the West would be ___.
patterns.note: 用對方熟悉的東西來類比

patterns.en: Every family does it a bit differently.
patterns.zh: 每個家庭的做法都有點不同。

patterns.en: You should experience it at least once.

chinglish.wrong: New Year is the time which everyone goes home.
chinglish.right: New Year is the time when everyone goes home.
chinglish.why: 時間後面接完整子句用 when（= at which），不能單獨用 which。

chinglish.wrong: This is the house my grandparents live.
chinglish.right: This is the house where my grandparents live. / …the house my grandparents live in.
chinglish.why: live 後面需要介系詞，要嘛用 where，要嘛句尾加 in。

chinglish.wrong: That's why the reason kids love it.
chinglish.right: That's the reason (why) kids love it. / That's why kids love it.
chinglish.why: the reason 和 why 可以一起用，但語序是 the reason why，不是 why the reason。

chinglish.wrong: We eat moon cake and grapefruit.
chinglish.why: 柚子是 pomelo，grapefruit 是葡萄柚。

grammar.title: 關係副詞 where / when / why
grammar.oneLiner: 修飾地點用 where、時間用 when、原因用 why，後面都接完整子句。
whenToUse: where = in / at which：the house where my grandparents live。
when = on / in which：the night when the moon is fullest。
why = for which：the reason why kids love it。
the reason why 可以只說 the reason 或 why：That's why kids love it.
可用 that 或省略：the day (that) we met / the reason (that) I called。
比較：the house where I live（where + 完整子句）vs the house which I bought（which 當 bought 的受詞）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 第 31 單元學過 who / which / that。這個單元的難點在於：什麼時候用 which、什麼時候用 where？關鍵是看後面的子句「缺不缺東西」：I bought ___（缺受詞）用 which；I live（完整，只缺介系詞的受詞）用 where。台灣人常把 which 和 where 混用，或是忘了句尾的介系詞。

examples.correct: This is the café where we first met.
examples.incorrect: This is the café which we first met.
examples.note: we first met 是完整子句，用 where。

examples.correct: This is the café which we visited last week.
I'll never forget the day when I moved to Taipei.
That's the reason why I love this festival.
Tainan is the city I grew up in.
examples.note: 省略 where，介系詞放句尾。

quiz.question: This is the temple ___ my parents got married.
quiz.explanation: 地點 + 完整子句用 where。

quiz.question: New Year's Eve is the night ___ families eat together.
Do you know the reason ___ we eat mooncakes?
This is the market ___ I visited yesterday.
Which is correct?
options: This is the town I grew up.
This is the town where I grew up.
This is the town which I grew up.
quiz.explanation: grow up 是完整子句，用 where。

slang.usage: 慶祝新年到來，源自敲鐘迎新年的傳統。

examples.en: We rang in the new year at Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 我們在台北 101 迎接新年。

examples.en: How are you ringing in the new year?

slang.usage: 用盡全力準備或做某事。

examples.en: My mom goes all out for Lunar New Year dinner.
examples.zh: 我媽準備年夜飯都傾盡全力。

examples.en: The team went all out for the final.

slang.usage: 兩件事相差很遠，通常用來對比。

examples.en: Life in Taipei is a far cry from my small hometown.
examples.zh: 台北的生活跟我的小家鄉差很多。

examples.en: This hotel is a far cry from the one in the photos.
examples.zh: 這間飯店跟照片上的差太多了。

slang.meaning: 這是一種（真實存在的）現象、這是這裡的習慣
slang.usage: 說明某個現象或習俗真的存在。Is that a thing? = 真的有這種事嗎？

examples.en: Barbecuing on Mid-Autumn Festival? Yeah, it's a thing here.
examples.zh: 中秋節烤肉？對，這裡就是這樣。

examples.en: Pineapple on pizza is a thing? Really?
examples.zh: 披薩上放鳳梨是真的有人這樣吃？

review.question: I'm looking forward to ___ my family for New Year.
review.explanation: 複習第 86 單元：look forward to + V-ing。

review.question: Which is the most formal?
options: We cordially invite you to attend.
review.explanation: 複習第 85 單元：正式語域。

review.question: My grandma always tells me ___ eat more at New Year dinner.
review.explanation: 複習第 83 單元：tell + 人 + to V。

review.question: As soon as midnight ___, everyone set off fireworks.
review.explanation: 複習第 79 單元：說故事用過去式。

review.question: Don't forget ___ your grandparents during the holiday.
review.explanation: 複習第 71 單元：forget to V。

review.question: We need to figure ___ who's bringing what to the barbecue.
A: Would you mind bringing drinks? B: ___
review.explanation: 複習第 23 單元：Not at all。

review.question: This is the restaurant ___ we had our New Year dinner.
review.explanation: 地點 + 完整子句用 where。
